rule: Per position, on 2019–2024 only: among the displayable windows (Full season = season to date, Last 1/2/3/4/5/6/8 completed games, Previous season), pick the one whose Allowed÷Usual ORDER best matches the next game's actual Allowed÷Usual (pairwise rank accuracy within each week's slate). It replaces Full season only if it beats Full season with a 95% cluster-bootstrap interval above 0 AND in at least 4 of the 6 seasons. The default is then confirmed on the locked 2025 holdout: a replacement must still beat Full season there, otherwise Full season stays. The board is called predictive for a position only if its default window's rank accuracy is above a coin flip (50%) with a 95% interval above 0 on 2019–2024 AND above 50% on 2025.
